instructions:
Observe the fixed-anchor historical scene using only observe, set_view, rotate_view, step_slice.
set_view accepts mode=4panel|3d|xy|xz|yz and resets the slice to the task anchor.
rotate_view requires 3d and accepts axis=x|y|z plus angle_degrees.
step_slice requires a single 2D mode and accepts signed integer steps; positive follows the plane normal.
Every successful call returns a fresh PNG and matching state. No pan, zoom, editing or historical queries.
The host provides the task initially and collects the final structured JSON answer; neither requires a tool.

tools.name: observe
tools.description: Return a fresh PNG of the current view and its exact state. Does not change the camera.

tools.name: set_view
tools.description: Switch among 4panel, 3d, xy, xz, yz and return a fresh PNG. Resets slice offset to zero at the fixed anchor. No zoom or pan.

mode.description: Display mode. Switching resets slice center to the fixed task anchor, preserving 3D orientation and physical field of view.
mode.title: Mode

tools.name: rotate_view
tools.description: Only in 3d mode: rotate about a fixed world axis at the fixed task anchor, using a signed right-hand angle in degrees. Return a fresh PNG; no mode auto-switch.

axis.description: Fixed world axis, using right-hand rule; affects the 3D camera around the current center.
axis.title: Axis

angle_degrees.description: Signed incremental angle in degrees. E.g. 30 rotates +30 degrees; -30 reverses it.
angle_degrees.title: Angle Degrees

tools.name: step_slice
tools.description: Only in xy/xz/yz mode: advance/reverse by signed voxel slice count along the current plane normal. Keep in-plane center and FOV fixed; return a fresh PNG. Reject ROI overflow.

steps.description: Signed slice count: positive advances along the normal axis, negative reverses. XY uses z, XZ uses y, YZ uses x. Only allowed in a single 2D slice mode.
steps.title: Steps
